Item.Name: POOL_ID
Item.Hint: Enter value for pooled component ID or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is
 SELECT unit_id, coll_date, component_prefix,
 components.product_code, expiry_date,
 product_desc, abo_short_name code_desc
 FROM components, valid_products, valid_abo_values
 WHERE pooled_component_id = :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id 
 AND chapter_id = :s_chapter_id 
 AND SUBSTR(components.product_code,1,5) =
 valid_products.product_code 
 AND components.system_label_decision = abo_label 
 AND valid_abo_values.unit_scheme_type = 
 decode(NVL(length(unit_id), 0),13,'I','C') 
 AND sysdate between valid_products.eff_date 
 AND nvl(valid_products.term_date,sysdate+365) ;
 

begin
 :pooled_components.chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :pooled_components.pool_id := :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id;
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('pooled_components');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 execute_query(FOR_UPDATE,NO_WAIT);
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :component_prefix := c1_rec.component_prefix;
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :ctrl_blk_1.expiry_date := c1_rec.expiry_date;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc := c1_rec.product_desc;
 :s_system_label_decision_desc := c1_rec.code_desc;
 :s_tot_components := nvl(:s_tot_components,0)+1;
 :ctrl_blk_1.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id , :coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id); 
 check_package_failure;

 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :ctrl_blk_2.pool_chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:ctrl_blk_2.pool_id,null,null);
 begin
 select 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from pooled_components
 where pool_id = :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_2.s_pool_id');
 show_error('1206');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
